root_cause.text: The `renesas_i3c_i3c_xfers()` function allocated a `renesas_i3c_xfer` structure via `renesas_i3c_alloc_xfer()` but never freed it on any return path, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "The xfer structure allocated by renesas_i3c_alloc_xfer() was never freed in the renesas_i3c_i3c_xfers() function." The patch adds `__free(kfree)` to the allocation to automatically free the memory when the variable goes out of scope, confirming the previously missing deallocation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Automatically free allocated xfer with __free(kfree) attribute to ensure cleanup on all exit paths.
intent_record.what: Moved the declaration of 'xfer' from a separate line to an initialization with '__free(kfree)' attribute, combining declaration and allocation.
intent_record.how: The allocation of 'xfer' now uses the automatic cleanup attribute '__free(kfree)', so 'kfree' will be called automatically when the variable goes out of scope, ensuring proper deallocation on all exit paths.
